body.message:
As per your request, please find below the 6-month rates for the 2 Bedroom + Maid Apartment at City Walk Building 2A:

August: AED 14,500
September: AED 17,400
October: AED 18,900
November: AED 21,000
December: AED 21,000
January: AED 20,000

Please note that a security deposit of AED 5,000 is required. The booking will be processed on a monthly basis only, with each month calculated as 30 nights.

Thank you.
